generation: 内置 ImageGen：人物造型与背景颜色；没有程序重绘人物
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: V20 layered 2D anime character animation sprite, bedtime clothes, standing-shy state.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET and mandatory pose/expression/identity/canvas reference. Image 2 is the already accepted same-outfit sprite and is ONLY the garment design reference, not a face or expression replacement.
Primary request: Change ONLY the clothes to the exact bedtime outfit in Image 2: cream button-front long-sleeve pajamas, soft strawberry-pink collar and cuffs, strawberry embroidery, loose full-length pink-and-cream gingham trousers with small strawberries. Remove the cat-ear hood from Image 1. No hood, no fleece, no dress. Match the outfit proportions and color blocks of Image 2, adapting only to the unchanged pose of Image 1.
Target action to keep unchanged: Keep her standing welcoming pose and EXACT shy open-eyed expression from Image 1: brighter blush, slightly timid eyebrows and small restrained smile. Left hand remains near chest; right open hand remains extended in the same place.
Invariants: leave the silver-white long hair, bangs and strands, pink hair clips, round youthful face, exact eyes/eyelids and blush/mouth shape, head position, light-Q proportions, body pose, hand and prop coordinates, camera and canvas framing exactly as in Image 1. Only garment features required by the clothing swap may change. Match Image 2's specific collar/hood, cuffs, trim, button/bow design, trouser pattern and color; do not import Image 2's eye expression or pose.
Backdrop: completely flat vivid chroma green #00FF00, no scenery, no cast shadow or ground. Preserve the subject's crisp separable silhouette. No green spill on skin, silver hair, garments or objects; clothing is opaque and low-saturation, never backdrop green.
Style: match Image 1's clean bright cel-anime sprite, delicate crisp linework, simple two or three shadow tones and smooth flat color fields. Zero painterly texture, watercolor, muddy shading, fuzz/grain, oily highlights or blurry glow.
Constraints: one all-ages fully and modestly clothed youthful character, no mature/sensual body, no text, watermark, extra objects, extra limbs or fingers. Do not change the target pose, prop, expression, crop, scale or aspect ratio. No character sheet, no duplicated panels.
